caption: The drawing depicts two garments against a plain, light beige background. The larger object, on the left, is a long cloak or robe that reaches below the knee, rendered in mostly dark gray with intricate decorative patterns in turquoise blue, gold-yellow, and black running along the front opening, the edges, and the lower hem. The gold-yellow border traces the edge of these turquoise panels. The garment appears to be fastened at the neck with a small, horizontal strap and has a piece of gray or brown fur hanging from the bottom hem. On the right, there is a smaller, matching piece that resembles a short jacket, shrug, or capelet, featuring the same color scheme of dark gray, turquoise, and gold-yellow, with geometric patterns and decorative trim along the edges. From the bottom of this smaller garment hang two long, narrow sections of animal fur or tails, predominantly brown and white. Both garments are ornately decorated and presented with careful detail to the texture and color of the materials.
title: Black Cotton Coat
